notes.title: Free to Play and Workshop support! Plus Upcoming 3D...
notes.content:
Hey all!

Very exciting news, the Mythic Archive is now Free to Play for players, you will no longer need to own a  copy of Mythic Archive to join a session in progress!

In addition, we are excited to announce the release of steam workshop support, allowing you to share the projects, systems, and content you spend your time on with the world! 

We are prepping for the next big push of the project, which is to integrate 3D Battlemaps into the software. This would be insanely innovative for the TTRPG space, and we are going to need your support on our upcoming Kickstarter to make this a reality! So please follow us over at our [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/grimdarkdevs/mythic-archive]pre-launch page[/url] and keep sharing the project with your friends! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40989880/4084ce4238330e688fc4335580a30a864d4adab6.png[/img]


This also comes with patch notes for the routine maintenance that has been happening over the last couple of weeks. We've added some new styling features to give your notes and writing more flair and worked on the overall comfort of the User Interface to make things a bit more streamlined. 


[h1]CHANGE LOG[/h1]
+Made System Association stronger
+Added an importer button for bulk importing of content
+Added a package button, to copy all your project contents into a single folder
+Fixed an issue when creating a new tab
+Bug Fixes
+Ctrl + = zoom in scaling hotkey added
+Workshop fixes
+Fixed an issue where a project wouldn't associate with a system during creation
+Fixed an issue where user display name wasn't being set properly
+Stats can now be presented as checkboxes within pages
+Fixed an issue where archived content wasn't loading properly
+Fixed an issue where read permissions allowed you to see the edit button
+Added P2P transfer for all missing media files during play
+Fixed buggy chat issues
+Added Max sizing to images and a share to chat button on right click
+Added 4 new types of sections Datapad, Documents, Parchment, Stones and Terminals
+Added an option to share sections (and quotes) to chat by right clicking on them
+Added a new input type (switch)
+Sorted stats for easier navigation
+Added bonus tag to inputs to help character sheet customization
+Fixed an issue where wrapping a section would add things in reverse order
+Left Clicking on Already rolled dice causes them to re-roll, right click now allows you to manually change them
+Added syntax for counting and indexing dice values `3d6|>3` counts the number of dice greater than 3 and `3d6|1` prints the value of the first dice in the pool
+Fixed an issue with a white screen problem
-Removed 32-bit windows support (Sorry, had to be done!)

notes.title: Transferring to F2P
notes.content:
We are transferring to F2P, until this is over switch to the 'testing' branch, otherwise your content won't save until we complete the transfer.

For who own Mythic Archive, you will be given a copy of "Mythic Archive - Host License" upon completion, and you won't experience any other changes (other than your players will now be able to join without any charge!)

Thanks for the Patience, excited to share the upcoming patch notes with everybody.

notes.title: Major Multiplayer Update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40989880/49fea1d4309200f1a3ab052dfe36f9748084c2cf.png[/img]

A ton of work was done this patch, adding a bunch of dynamic systems that pretty much entirely changes how you can use the tool.
